> The [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paypal]] overview labels Web **Direct** and recommends it for new Web integrations (overview raw lines 55–65), whereas this guide is specifically for an existing Advanced-flow **Web API-only** integration and requires redirect handling, with a `RedirectShopper` example (this raw lines 23–30 and 621–635).
